comparison_limit: Same four scenario patterns and budgets, but policy training differs in PPO symmetry augmentation/mirror loss, roll reward 0->0.5, and anchor Z termination 0.25->0.15. No single-factor causal attribution; current thresholds are historical training values.

definitions.anchor_z: absolute z error, separate from 3D and horizontal errors
definitions.hip_residual: abs(left+right) in degrees; reference-adjusted residual also included
definitions.phase: pre-action reference frame / 50 Hz; sampled control state follows 20 ms; physics follows substep
definitions.sampling: Each case 1000 control and 4000 physics samples; mean actions; fixed frame zero; single seed and startup draw.
